name: claude-code-plugins
description: Anthropic's Claude Code plugins, installed from the claude-plugins-official repository

plugins.name: claude-flow
plugins.description: AI agent orchestration using claude-flow (RuFlo) — coordinate swarms of specialized agents, hive-mind consensus, and persistent task automation within Claude Code

plugins.name: anthropic-mcp
plugins.description: Registers the official Anthropic MCP server, giving Claude Code direct access to Claude models and the Anthropic API

plugins.name: agent-sdk-dev
plugins.description: Development kit for working with the Claude Agent SDK

plugins.name: business-agent
plugins.description: Manage the business-agent managed-agent lifecycle: setup, run, and update sessions via the Claude Agent SDK

plugins.name: claude-opus-4-5-migration
plugins.description: Migrate your code and prompts from Sonnet 4.x and Opus 4.1 to Opus 4.5.

author.name: code-review
author.description: Automated code review for pull requests using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring to filter false positives

author.name: commit-commands
author.description: Commands for git commit workflows including commit, push, and PR creation

author.name: explanatory-output-style
author.description: Adds educational insights about implementation choices and codebase patterns (mimics the deprecated Explanatory output style)

author.name: feature-dev
author.description: Comprehensive feature development workflow with specialized agents for codebase exploration, architecture design, and quality review

author.name: frontend-design
author.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

author.name: hookify
author.description: Easily create custom hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors by analyzing conversation patterns or from explicit instructions. Define rules via simple markdown files.

author.name: learning-output-style
author.description: Interactive learning mode that requests meaningful code contributions at decision points (mimics the unshipped Learning output style)

author.name: plugin-dev
author.description: Comprehensive toolkit for developing Claude Code plugins. Includes 7 expert skills covering hooks, MCP integration, commands, agents, and best practices. AI-assisted plugin creation and validation.

author.name: pr-review-toolkit
author.description: Comprehensive PR review agents specializing in comments, tests, error handling, type design, code quality, and code simplification

author.name: ralph-loop
author.description: Interactive self-referential AI loops for iterative development. Claude works on the same task repeatedly, seeing its previous work, until completion.

author.name: security-guidance
author.description: Security review for Claude-generated code. Pattern-based warnings on edits, LLM-powered diff review on Stop, and an agentic commit reviewer that catches injection, XSS, SSRF, hardcoded secrets, and 25+ other vulnerability classes.

author.name: ruflo-core
author.description: Foundation plugin — registers the ruflo MCP server (300+ tools across memory/agentdb/embeddings/hooks/aidefence/neural/autopilot/browser/agent/swarm), provides 3 generalist agents (coder/researcher/reviewer), 3 first-run skills, and a curated plugin-discovery catalog

author.name: ruflo-swarm
author.description: Agent teams, swarm coordination, Monitor streams, and worktree isolation — wraps 4 swarm_* + 8 agent_* MCP tools (12 total) plus 6 topologies (hierarchical / mesh / hierarchical-mesh / ring / star / adaptive)

author.name: ruflo-autopilot
author.description: Autonomous /loop-driven task completion with learning, prediction, and progress tracking — wraps 10 autopilot_* MCP tools (status/enable/disable/config/reset/log/progress/learn/history/predict)

author.name: ruflo-federation
author.description: Cross-installation agent federation with zero-trust security, peer discovery, consensus-based task routing, and per-call budget circuit breaker (ADR-097)

author.name: free-claude-code-mcp
author.description: MCP server integration for free-claude-code proxy. Enables agents to route requests through multiple AI providers with custom configuration and automatic fallbacks.
